title: Snowflake Cloud Data Warehouse and Analytics Platform
raw_description: BC Hydro is seeking a qualified vendor to design, implement, and support a Snowflake-based cloud data warehouse. The scope includes migration of legacy Oracle data marts, ETL/ELT pipeline development using dbt, Power BI dashboard creation, and data governance framework implementation. The vendor must demonstrate proven Snowflake SnowPro Core and Advanced certifications, experience with large-scale data migration in regulated utilities environments, and a strong track record with BC public-sector clients. Preferred capabilities include Azure Data Factory integration, automated data quality testing, and executive-level reporting. Contract term: 2 years with two 1-year renewal options.

ground_truth.rationale: Perfect capability match — Snowflake, dbt, Power BI, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data governance are all the client's primary capabilities. BC Hydro is an ideal client profile (Crown corporation, regulated sector). Contract value in target range.
